description: The bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," compares the performance of three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the "Ratio (%)" on a scale from 50 to 90, with major gridlines at 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90. For the "Movies" category, Llama3 and Qwen2 both achieve a ratio of approximately 90%, while ChatGPT scores around 73%. In the "Songs" category, Qwen2 again leads with a ratio of about 90%, followed by Llama3 at roughly 84%, and ChatGPT at approximately 62%. For "Basketball," Llama3 scores around 67%, ChatGPT is at about 61%, and Qwen2 has the lowest score of approximately 57%. The chart shows that Qwen2 performs best in "Movies" and "Songs," while Llama3 performs best in "Basketball," with ChatGPT consistently scoring lower than the other two models in all categories.
